meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页交互与数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器执行重复操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions and extract web data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control a browser programmatically for repetitive tasks

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 能通过小脚本控制真实浏览器：打开网址、点击、填表、截图、抓取数据，并能在多次操作间保持页面状态。
howto.when: 当你说“打开某网址”、“点击”、“填表”等，或要求截图、抓取数据、测试网站时触发。

say.text: 打开 example.com 并截图给我看
say.note: 启动浏览器打开该网址并保存截图

say.text: 把这个页面的所有文章标题抓下来

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can automate a real browser via small scripts: navigate to URLs, click elements, fill forms, take screenshots, and extract data. Page state persists across script executions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when users say 'go to', 'click on', 'fill out', etc., or ask for screenshots, scraping, or testing.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot for me.
say_en.note: Launches browser, navigates, and captures screenshot.

say_en.text: Click the 'Login' button on the page.
say_en.note: Locates the element via accessibility snapshot and clicks.

say_en.text: Extract all article titles from this page.
say_en.note: Scrapes the page and returns the titles.
